int8: per token row maxabs/127 scale, nearest integer clipped to [-127,127]
ternary: per token row meanabs scale; abs(weight)>=0.7*scale retains sign; packed 2 bits/coefficient including unused fourth code
scoring: cosine of normalized mean static token vectors; no task-specific fitting in this cycle
validation: same 553 eligible validation pairs; report 54 scope exclusions; no reserve scoring
controls: BM25 statistics from development documents, token overlap; compare previous lexical controls on the same cohort
primary: FP32 cosine; validation AUC>=0.60 and >=0.03 above matched BM25 before considering a separately frozen reserve1 protocol
normalization: pinned WordPiece/BertNormalizer; no automatic special tokens; discard unknown IDs; no silent input truncation
limitations: general English pretrained source; public-data pretraining overlap unknown; no code retrieval or agent cost claim
